title: fix(plugin-detail): record:quick_actions maps an action spec variant onto Button
body:
Fixes #12986
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`record:quick_actions` passed an action's spec `variant` (`primary | secondary | danger | ghost | link`) to the `Button` primitive raw. `Button`'s cva knows `default | destructive | outline | secondary | ghost | link`, so `danger` and `primary` matched no variant and drew unstyled, and a declared `danger` also beat the block's own `destructive`.

`packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-quick-actions.tsx` now maps a declared action variant through a typed table (`SPEC_ACTION_TO_BUTTON_VARIANT`, keyed by `ActionDef['variant']`): `danger` to `destructive`, `primary` to `default`, `secondary` / `ghost` / `link` pass through. That is the reading the record header (`isDestructiveAction` in `containers.tsx`) and the row menu (`toButtonVariant` in `RowActionMenu.tsx`, the mapping in `DeclaredActionsBar.tsx`) already give it. The block's `variant` (Button vocabulary) is the fallback only for an action that declares none. The `(action as any).variant` cast and the `variant: any` prop are gone; the prop is typed `ButtonProps['variant']`.

The mapping is kept local and small: no package `plugin-detail` depends on exports one (`toButtonVariant` is file-local in `plugin-grid`, the app-shell mapping is inline). No spec change, no new key; the header and the row menu are untouched.

## Tests

New `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-quick-actions.variant-12986.test.tsx`, driving the real renderer under `RecordContextProvider`:
- (a) `variant: 'danger'` draws `bg-destructive` (block variant `outline`, so the action's own variant must win);
- (b) `variant: 'primary'` draws `bg-primary`, the filled default;
- (c) CONTROL: no variant declared takes the block's `destructive`.

Ablation (one-shot, not kept): `SPEC_ACTION_TO_BUTTON_VARIANT[action.variant]` replaced by `(action.variant as any)` through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob 26f6e5b4a645 to bdf244d81d2a): (a) and (b) red, (c) green. Restore proved by blob hash: after restore 26f6e5b4a645 == HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports the renderer by relative path (source), so no build sits between the mutation and the run.
